Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

GROUND BEEF BULGOGI A quick, savory Korean‑inspired beef bowl that’s perfect for weeknights. INGREDIENTS Main 1 lb ground beef 1 onion, sliced 1 tbsp minced garlic Oil, for cooking Sesame oil, for finishing Sesame seeds, garnish Chopped scallion, garnish Kimchi or radish kimchi, for serving Sauce 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp mirin 4 tbsp soy sauce (low sodium preferred) 1 tbsp Korean plum syrup* *Sub: 1 tbsp water + 1 tsp apple cider vinegar INSTRUCTIONS 1. Peel and slice the onion; set aside. 2. Combine brown sugar, mirin, soy sauce, and plum syrup (or substitute). Mix well and set aside. 3. Heat a little oil in a pan. Add sliced onions and cook for 1 minute. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Add ground beef and break it into small pieces. Once the beef is about 30% cooked, pour in the sauce. Let it simmer until the sauce reduces and evaporates — stir occasionally. (This part takes a little time, but it’s worth it.) 5. Drizzle with sesame oil and give it a final mix. 6. Assemble your bowl with rice, scallions, sesame seeds, and kimchi/ veggie of choice. Enjoy!

Marry Me Chicken Bites 💍 Minimal steps, maximum taste: a no-fuss dinner to win hearts. Ingredients: -2 chicken breasts (14oz / 400g), cubed -1 tbsp olive oil -Seasonings: 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp seasoning salt, 1 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper -1/4 cup white cooking wine -2 tbsp butter -5 garlic cloves, minced -1 tbsp neutral oil (I used avo) -1 shallot, minced -1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped -2 tbsp sun-dried tomato oil (from the jar of tomatoes) -3/4 cup heavy cream (half & half works too), room temp -1/2 cup fresh parmesan cheese, grated -Fresh chopped parsley or basil, for garnish For the mashed potatoes: -3 pounds russet potatoes or Yukon gold -1/4 cup salted butter, melted -5 garlic cloves -3/4 cup milk or cream -Salt & pepper, to taste Instructions: 1. Cube the chicken breasts into large bite-sized pieces. Pat them dry (super important for browning), toss with 1 tbsp each of olive oil and sun-dried tomato oil along with the seasonings. 2. Heat neutral oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, add the chicken cubes. Cook for about 3-5 minutes per side until golden and sizzling. Reduce heat to medium-low, toss in butter and garlic, and gently sauté for 2-3 minutes until fragrant. 3. Still using the same pan, deglaze with white cooking wine (optional) - scraping up the garlicky goodness stuck to the bottom. Add the minced shallot, chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 more tbsp of the sun-dried tomato oil then caramelize for 3-4 minutes, stirring often. 4. Slowly pour in the heavy cream. Stir and bring to a light simmer. Add the fresh parmesan and reduce heat to low - let it thicken for 4-5 minutes. 5. Recommended plating: Lay down a generous bed of warm mashed potatoes (or rice). Place your chicken bites on top. Ladle that luscious marry me sauce right over the top. Finish with a sprinkle of fresh parsley if you're feeling fancy (or trying to make your situationship official). #dinnerideas #easydinner #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinnerideastiktok

Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

9 Best Things to Do in Marrakesh 🕌✨ 1) Stay in a Riad 🛏️  feel the authentic Moroccan vibe, from the mosaic tiles to the whisper-quiet courtyards. Riads offer privacy, fewer crowds, and a home-away-from-home feel with traditional decor, often a peaceful rooftop terrace, and staff who treat you like family. Perfect for a truly Moroccan experience without the hotel hustle. 2) Best Coffee at Bacha Coffee ☕️✨ (Location: https://goo.gl/maps/6u3Xx9J9xqv1w9Qw7) Silky espresso, perfectly balanced blends, and a chic, relaxed atmosphere. Great latte art, friendly baristas, and a bright, stylish space to post your vibes. Pro tip: try their signature crush coffee and pastry pairing. 3) Explore the Souks 🧿🌀 Fun tip: haggle with a smile, never agree to the first price! Make it a playful game, sample spices, and test your bargaining skills. Lose yourself in ribbons of color, leather, pottery, and lamps. The thrill of the find is half the fun! 4) Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa 🕌 A jaw-dropping historic site with intricate tilework, carved wood, and serene courtyards. It’s a perfect spot for photos that scream old-world Marrakech charm. 5) Jardin Majorelle 🌿💙 iconic cobalt-blue paths, lush botanical displays, and a peaceful escape from the market buzz. A must-see for color lovers and plant enthusiasts, plus it’s connected to the Yves Saint Laurent legacy. 6) Ourika Valley Day Trip 🚙🌄 about 1 hour from central Marrakech (depending on traffic). What to expect: stunning valley scenery, Berber villages, waterfalls, and a cooler climate. A refreshing break from the medina with photo-worthy viewpoints. 7) Agafay Desert Experience 🐫🏜️ Highlights: camel ride under the open sky, squad  bike moments, and magical desert views. Luxe touch: stay at a desert camp with plush lounges, gourmet meals, and starlit dinners. Perfect for a memorable  outing. 8) Dinner at La Trattoria 🍝🇮🇹  warm, cozy ambiance with authentic Italian flavors in Marrakech. Great for a relaxed evening, fresh pastas, and a lively dining vibe after a day of exploration. 9) Jemaa el-Fnaa - The Heart of Marrakech 🎭💃 Do it for the vibes: bustling square, street performances, snake charmers, and a feast for the senses. Pro tip: bring some cash for photos with performers and for quick bites. Best times: late afternoon into evening when the energy peaks. #Marrakesh #Morocco #TravelTikTok #Riads #Souks

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

Serves: 4–6 Ingredients * 2 lbs chicken (thin-cut breasts, regular breasts, diced chicken, or boneless skinless thighs) * 1 (7.5 oz) tub Garden Vegetable Cream Cheese * ½ cup jalapeño jelly * ½ cup chicken broth * 3 tbsp ranch seasoning * Shredded mozzarella or pepper jack cheese Garnish with bacon crumbles or fresh parsley! Chicken Seasoning * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray. 3. Place the chicken in the baking dish 4. Season the chicken with the garlic powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper. 5. In a bowl, whisk together:     * Softened Garden Vegetable Cream Cheese     * Jalapeño jelly     * Chicken broth     * Ranch seasoning 6. Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken. 7. Cover tightly with foil and bake according to the times below. 8. Remove from oven the last 5-10 minutes. take off foil, and top with shredded cheese. Place back in oven to melt cheese. LOOK IDENTITY — AETHER NOMAD 9099 🛸🤎🤍🩶 📍 Date officielle de naissance du look : 22.08.9099 Un look imaginé pour une époque où la mode ne cherche plus à suivre le futur… elle vient directement de lui. Le pantalon cargo à double ceinture signé @flyerrer.official conserve l’ADN street des années 90/2000, mais ici, il est propulsé dans une autre dimension. Taille volontairement abaissée, volumes XXL, poches cargo, nuances beige poussière et chocolat : la silhouette semble avoir été retrouvée dans une archive venue de 9099. Cette fois, le haut change complètement l’histoire. La maille zippée à col montant et ses détails effet fourrure construisent une silhouette plus sculpturale, plus mystérieuse, presque extraterrestre. Sa palette claire dialogue parfaitement avec le pantalon et crée un contraste entre douceur, puissance et futurisme. Les deux ceintures deviennent une véritable signature visuelle. Les sneakers massives ancrent le look dans le présent, tandis que les lunettes futuristes et le chapeau que j’ai imaginé transportent l’ensemble bien au-delà de notre époque. 🕶️🛸 Et le plus important ? Je n’ai pas simplement assemblé des vêtements. J’ai construit une identité. La façon de porter chaque pièce, les proportions, les accessoires, les matières et l’attitude ont été pensés pour créer une silhouette que l’on remarque avant même de comprendre pourquoi. Aujourd’hui, les gens tournent la tête. Ils demandent des photos. Ils cherchent à comprendre. En 9099, ils chercheront probablement à comprendre d’où cette archive est arrivée. ⚡️ Conseil de style : Ne cherche pas à porter ce que tout le monde porte. Cherche à créer quelque chose que les autres n’ont encore jamais vu. La mode devient puissante lorsqu’elle ne demande pas : « Est-ce que ça plaît ? » Elle demande : « Est-ce que ça va rester dans leur mémoire ? » Un vrai look ne suit pas l’époque. Il lui donne quelque chose à rattraper. 🛸🤎🤍🩶🕶️ @flyerrer.official 🖤 @_startexceedend_ 🤍 #aethernomad9099

✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

For all of you asking - the Osta app link is in my bio, or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play 🫶 🤎Brownie Batter Lava Cake - 330 g (2 ¾ cups) cake flour, sifted - 70 g (¾ cup) Majestic Dutch-process cocoa powder - 2 ½ tsp baking powder - ½ tsp baking soda - 1 tsp fine sea salt - 360 g (1 ½ cups) organic cane sugar - 360 g (1 ½ cups) non-dairy milk, room temp - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar - 120 g (½ cup) plain non-dairy yogurt, room temp - 240 g (1 cup) neutral oil (grapeseed, canola, sunflower) - 2 tsp vanilla bean paste Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (or 345°F high altitude). Grease and line three 8-inch pans with parchment. 2. In a medium bowl, whisk flour, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. 3. In a measuring cup, combine milk and vinegar; let curdle 5 minutes. Whisk in yogurt, oil, and vanilla. 4. In a large bowl, whisk sugar into wet mixture until dissolved. 5. Sift dry mix into wet; fold gently until smooth. 6. Divide evenly into pans and bake 22-25 minutes, until tops spring back. Cool 10–15 minutes, remove from pans, wrap, and chill. 🤎Brownie Lava  - 100 g (½ cup, packed) light brown sugar - 50 g (¼ cup) organic cane sugar - 70 g (5 tbsp) non-dairy butter - 40 g (½ cup) Majestic Dutch-process cocoa powder - 40 g (5 tbsp) heat-treated all-purpose flour - 80 g (⅓ cup) non-dairy cream - 1 tsp vanilla bean powder - ½ tsp fine sea salt - 70 g (½ cup) chopped non-dairy chocolate (~50% cocoa) - 60–90 g (¼–⅓ cup) non-dairy milk, to thin if a looser lava is desired Instructions 1. Melt butter with both sugars over medium heat until glossy. Keep gritty; don’t dissolve all sugar. 2. Whisk in cocoa + flour until paste-like. 3. Stream in cream gradually until molten but thick. 4. Stir in vanilla and salt. 5. Let cool 5–7 minutes until warm but pourable. Fold in chopped chocolate — it should soften but not fully melt. Let cool to room temp before assembling. 6. Whisk in 60–90 g non-dairy milk at the very end, until desired consistency is reached. Use immediately.  🤎Raw Brownie Batter Squares (Layer + Garnish) - 100 g (½ cup, packed) brown sugar - 50 g (¼ cup) sugar - 90 g (6 tbsp) non-dairy butter, room temp - 60 g (½ cup) Majestic Dutch-process cocoa powder - 120 g (1 cup) AP flour - 2–3 tbsp non-dairy cream - 1 tsp vanilla bean paste - ½ tsp fine sea salt - 70 g (½ cup) chopped non-dairy chocolate (~50% cocoa) Instructions 1. Cream butter with sugars until fluffy. 2. Mix in cocoa, flour, and salt until sandy. 3. Add vanilla + cream; mix to a stiff dough. 4. Fold in chopped chocolate. 5. Press into a parchment-lined pan, chill 30 minutes, then cut into small squares. 🤎Chocolate Buttercream - 339 g (1 ½ cups) non-dairy butter, room temp - 510 g (4 ½ cups) powdered sugar, sifted - 68 g (½ cup + 1 tbsp) Majestic Dutch-process cocoa powder - Pinch tsp fine sea salt - 2 tsp vanilla bean paste - 45-68 g (3–4½ cup) non-dairy cream *(start with 3 tbsp; add to desired texture)* Instructions 1. Beat butter until creamy. 2. Add powdered sugar, cocoa, salt, and vanilla. Beat on low, then whip on high until fluffy. 3. Stream in cream until smooth and silky. 🤎Assembly 1. Place first cake layer on board. Pipe a buttercream dam. 2. Spoon in brownie batter lava (thicker or thinner depending on preference) and scatter a few brownie batter squares. 3. Repeat with second layer, then add final cake. 4. Frost outside with chocolate buttercream. 5. Garnish with more brownie batter squares and drizzle extra lava over the top. 6. Slice → rich chocolate layers spill with molten brownie batter, studded with chewy brownie bites. 🤎To Serve For the ultimate gooey effect, microwave a chilled slice for 8–10 seconds before serving. The heat reactivates the lava, giving you that molten flow on demand. #chocolatecake #lavacake #brownie #vegancake #browniecake

warm, gooey, molten chocolate lava cakes for 2 🤎 these perfectly portioned lava cakes for 2 are easy enough to make on a whim but bougie enough to feel super special aka they’re EXACTLY what you should be making this valentine’s day. the full recipe lives in my cookbook Sweet Tooth on page 268 (grab your copy in my profile) love is in the air so I’m sharing it here too 💕 enjoyyy  Ingredients ¼ cup unsalted butter ½ cup chocolate chips ¼ cup packed light brown sugar 1 large egg plus 1 large egg yolk, at room temperature 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 tablespoon Dutch-processed cocoa powder 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour ⅛ teaspoon salt Vanilla ice cream or confectioners’ sugar, for topping 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. Generously butter and cocoa-dust two 6-oz ramekins (or three 4-oz ones 🤓) 2. Melt butter and chocolate in the microwave, stirring until smooth. 3. Whisk sugar, egg, yolk, and vanilla until pale (i recommend a hand mixer for ease!!). Stir in the melted chocolate mixture until combined, then gently fold in flour, cocoa, and salt. 4. Divide batter between ramekins. Bake 10–11 min (for 6-oz ramekins) or 7-8 minutes (for 4-oz ramekins), until the cakes are puffed up and the edges are set but the center is still a little wobbly. 5. Rest 2–3 min, invert onto a plate, and serve immediately with ice cream or powdered sugar.

Puerto Rican pollo guisado 🇵🇷🥘🍗🌿 Dinner ready in 30 minutes ⏲️  Chicken marinade  Drums (3x) and thighs (4x) 1 tbsp complete seasoning with adobo  1 tbsp of garlic powder  1 tsp of oregano and cumin 1/2 tsp salt 2 tbsp of sofrito  1 sazon packet  Drizzle of olive oil  Marinate for 30 mins to an hour  Pollo guisado  Half an onion  Half a green and red bell pepper  3 garlic cloves  Half can of tomato sauce  2 bay leaves  1/2 tsp adobo  1 packet of sazon 1/2 tsp chicken bouillon  1 tbsp of sofrito  Olives  2 medium sized russet potatoes  Directions  Clean your chicken and add seasonings, sofrio and oil to chicken and let marinate for 30 mins to an hour. Before cooking chicken take out the fridge to allow it to get to room temperature. In a pan add oil and brown chicken on both sides then remove chicken.  Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender. ✨Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wrap 🌯 Ingredients Chicken * 500g chicken thigh or breast Marinade * 1 tsp cayenne powder * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * Salt to taste * 1 tsp oregano * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp black pepper *1/2 tsp red chilli flakes * 1 tbsp ginger & garlic paste *1tbsp oil Garlic Parmesan Sauce * 1 tbsp butter * 2–3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 small white onion, finely chopped * 270ml double cream * ½ cup whole milk * 1 tsp cayenne powder * Salt to taste * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp oregano * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan Parmesan Fries * Fries * Parmesan cheese * Cayenne powder * Garlic powder * Salt to taste For the Wrap * Tortilla wraps * Mozzarella cheese * Parmesan cheese * Oil, for frying Method Chicken * Marinate the chicken with all the marinade ingredients for at least 30 minutes. * Heat 2 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp oil in a pan. * Cook the chicken over medium heat for 4–5 minutes per side, or until fully cooked. Slice into strips. Garlic Parmesan Sauce * Melt the butter with a little oil. Sauté the garlic until lightly golden. * Add the onion and cook until softened and lightly golden. * Add the cream and milk, then stir in all the seasonings. * Cook for 2–3 minutes over medium heat. * Add the Parmesan and mix until smooth and creamy. Parmesan Fries * Toss the fries with Parmesan, cayenne, garlic powder and a little salt. Assemble * Spread about 2 tbsp of garlic Parmesan sauce over a tortilla. * Add Parmesan fries and sliced chicken. * Top with mozzarella and Parmesan. * Fold tightly into a wrap. Crisp the Wrap * Heat 1–2 tbsp oil in a pan over medium-low heat. * Cook the wrap for about 2 minutes on each side, until golden and crispy. * Serve with Parmesan sauce and fries. They always ask why I didn’t make more | full recipe ⬇️ Smoked to perfection with @harmosgrill flavored pellets Serves: 6–8  Total Time: ~2–3 hours (including marinade) Ingredients Chicken 3–4 lbs bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (non-negotiable) 3–4 tbsp spicy brown mustard 2 tbsp Cuso’s Hot Honey Seasoning 2 tbsp Cuso’s Roasted Garlic & Onion Seasoning Grill / Smoke Harmos wood pellets: Spanish Barbecue Pirate & Turkish Barbecue Traveler Jalapeño Green Sauce 2–3 jalapeños (adjust for heat) 1 cup fresh cilantro 2–3 garlic cloves ½ cup Greek yogurt 2–3 tbsp olive oil Salt, to taste Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Marinate the Chicken Add chicken thighs to a large bowl. Coat fully with spicy brown mustard. Season generously with Cuso’s Hot Honey + Roasted Garlic & Onion seasoning. Mix until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours (overnight preferred). 2. Preheat the Grill Preheat your pellet grill to 350°F. Load with Harmos pellets (Spanish Barbecue Pirate + Turkish Barbecue Traveler) for deep smoky flavor with paprika, garlic, rosemary, and spice notes. 3. Make the Jalapeño Green Sauce Add jalapeños, cilantro, garlic, Greek yogurt, olive oil, salt, and pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning or heat. Chill until ready to serve. 4. Smoke the Chicken Place chicken directly on the grill grates. Cook for about 1 hour, until internal temp reaches 160°F. 5. Crank the Heat Increase grill temp to 500°F. Cook until chicken hits 180°F internal and skin gets crispy with great color. 6. Serve Remove from grill and rest a few minutes. Serve with the jalapeño green sauce on the side or drizzled over top. #HarmosGrill  #HarmosWoodPellets  #HarmosFlavoredPellets

BAKED HERB CHICKEN + POTATOES + CARROTS 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken • 300 g potatoes • 150 g carrots • 2 tbsp olive oil • Oregano or parsley • Salt & pepper 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Season everything with oil + herbs Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25–30 min Cook until golden and tender Divide into containers 🌶 6. Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. Polish Smalec 🇵🇱 | Poor Man's Butter They call it Poor Man's Butter, so I guess the rich are missing out. Polish Smalec is a rich, savory spread made by slowly rendering pork fat with bacon, onions, apples and marjoram. Once cooled, it becomes firm and perfectly spreadable. Best served generously on fresh rustic bread with pickles or fresh tomatoes. Recipe 👇 Poor Man's Butter – Polish Smalec ( Traditional Bacon & Apple Spread ) Ingredients ◆ 500 g ( 1.1 lb ) pork fat, cut into small cubes or coarsely ground ◆ 500 g ( 1.1 lb ) pork belly or fatty bacon, cut into small cubes or coarsely ground ◆ 3 onions, finely diced ◆ 2 apples, peeled and diced ◆ 1 tsp salt ◆ ½ tsp ground black pepper ◆ 1 tsp dried marjoram Instructions 1️⃣ Place the pork fat in a large heavy-bottomed pot or skillet. Cook over low heat for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until a good amount of fat has rendered. 2️⃣ Add the pork belly or fatty bacon. Continue cooking slowly over low heat for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until the pieces become golden brown and much of their fat has rendered. 3️⃣ Add the diced onions and apples. Continue cooking until the onions are soft and translucent and everything begins to turn golden. 4️⃣ Stir in the salt, black pepper, and dried marjoram. Remove from the heat and mix well. 5️⃣ Carefully pour the hot mixture into clean jars or a large glass bowl. 6️⃣ Let it cool completely until the rendered fat turns pale, firm, and spreadable. Serving Suggestions Spread generously over fresh bread and serve with pickles or fresh tomatoes. The rich, savory spread is especially delicious with a little salt and a side of crunchy pickled vegetables. #PolishFood #PolishSmalec #PoorMansButter #TasteTheEast #EasternEuropeanFood

Ingredients You’ll Need: 1 cup baking soda 1/2 cup cornstarch 1/2 cup sugar 2–4 tablespoons warm water  (mix with food coloring of your choice) 1 tablespoon cream of tartar Step-by-Step Instructions: Mix the dry ingredients In a large mixing bowl, combine the baking soda, cornstarch, sugar, and cream of tartar. Stir until evenly distributed. Prepare the colored water In a small bowl, add a few drops of food coloring to the warm water. Adjust the intensity of the color by adding more or fewer drops. Combine wet and dry ingredients Gradually add the colored water to the dry mixture, 1 tablespoon at a time. Mix with a spoon or your hands until the sand reaches your desired consistency—moist and moldable, but not sticky. You may not need all the water, so add it slowly! Test and play Once the mixture holds its shape when squeezed, it’s ready for playtime! If it feels too dry, add a few drops of water. If it’s too sticky, sprinkle in a bit more cornstarch. Prepare the Chicken Clean the chicken using 1 part vinegar to 2 parts water. Remove the insides, then butterfly the chicken by cutting out the backbone with kitchen shears. Lay the chicken meat‑side up, pat dry, and press down firmly to flatten. Season generously with the listed seasonings, including salt and cracked black pepper on the underside. 2. Cook the Chicken Preheat the oven to 375°F. Heat a large skillet over medium‑high. Once hot, sear the whole chicken skin‑side down until browned, about 4–5 minutes per side. If cooking multiple chickens, repeat the process. Transfer the browned chicken(s) to a baking dish. Add about 1/3 cup water to the bottom of the dish, cover, and place in the oven while you prepare the sauce 3. Prepare the Sauce In the same skillet used for searing, add diced shallots, garlic, and chopped rosemary. Cook for 3–4 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the chicken. Deglaze with 1/2 cup Sherry cooking wine and cook for 2–3 minutes. Add 2 – 2.5 cups heavy whipping cream, whisking to combine. Season with the listed sauce seasonings and cook for 3–4 minutes, whisking occasionally. 4. Finish the Dish Remove the chicken from the oven and pour the cream sauce over the top. Return to the oven and cook for 60–90 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone. Baste the chicken with the cream sauce every 30 minutes, stirring the sauce before each baste. For reference: a 3–4 lb chicken typically cooks in about 1 hour and 20 minutes. 5. Serve Serve the chicken over mashed potatoes or rice, and garnish with parsley. #cookingvideos #chickenaupoivre #recipes #fyp #mashedpotatoes

videos.caption: Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

videos.caption: Crockpot Teriyaki Chicken 🍗 🔥 Crockpot Series Episode 4: Teriyaki Chicken This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you got. This teriyaki chicken is sweet, savory, tender and packed with flavor. The crockpot does the work and you take the credit! 🙌🏽🔥 Frying pan: @anolon Seasoning: @thebeardedbutchers Ingredients: 2lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs 1 medium onion, sliced 2Tbsp butter, optional for searing 1 cup shoyu 1/4 cup water 1 cup brown sugar 2 Tbsp minced garlic 1 Tbsp ground ginger 2 Tbsp sesame oil 2 Tbsp rice vinegar 3 Tbsp cornstarch 1 Tbsp gochugaru, optional 1 tsp honey, optional Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken thighs dry then lightly season with SPG for extra color and flavor when we brown in a skillet. heat the butter in a skillet and sear the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side. The chicken does not need to be fully cooked. 2. Place the sliced onion in the bottom of the @crockpot and arrange the chicken thighs on top. 3. Whisk together the ingredients and the sauce over the chicken. 4. Cover and cook on LOW for 4½ hours or HIGH for 2–2½ hours, until the chicken is tender and reaches at least 185°F. 5. During the final 30 minutes, add broccoli in (optional) 6. Serve the chicken over steamed rice, spoon that teriyaki sauce over everything and finish with green onions and optional sesame seeds. 🤤 It’s flavorful, family-friendly and ridiculously easy. Make this for someone special and let the crockpot take care of the rest. 😂🔥 #teriyakichicken #hawaiitiktok #easyrecipes #crockpot #fallrecipes

Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Chicken Enchilada Rice Bake🔥508 cals 48g protein 7g fat 63g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into bitesized pieces 1½ cups jasmine rice, uncooked 1 can (10 oz) mild red enchilada sauce 1 3/4 cups chicken broth 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1 cup corn, drained 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed 1 small can mild diced green chiles  2 tbsp minced garlic 100g reduced-fat Mexican-blend cheese Seasoning blend: 2 tsp chili powder 1½ tsp ground cumin 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp dried oregano Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°F. 2. Grab a 9x13 baking dish - add the chicken breasts, 1½ cups uncooked jasmine rice, diced onion, bell pepper, corn, black beans, green chiles and minced garlic directly to the baking dish. 3. Season with chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, oregano, salt and black pepper. Pour in the 10-ounce can of enchilada sauce, 1 3/4 cups of warm chicken broth 4. Spread it into an even layer and make sure the rice is submerged beneath the liquid. 5. Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes. 6. Remove the foil and sprinkle 150g of reduced-fat Mexican-blend cheese evenly over the top. 7. Return it to the oven uncovered for another 10–15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, the rice is tender and the chicken has reached 165°F. 8. Let it rest for 10 minutes so the rice can absorb the remaining liquid. 9. Divide into six servings and finish with your favorite toppings. Serve hot & enjoy! This is my new favourite high-protein comfort meal 🤤 Think chukauni… but with juicy golden chicken, smoky mustard oil tadka, garlic-y curd, and those Nepali-style flavours that just hit different. It’s rich, tangy, spicy, creamy — and honestly perfect with soft rotis or steaming hot rice. Nepali Style Chicken Chukauni  🥣 Serves: 3 🔥 Macros (per serving): Calories: 374 kcal | Protein: 38 g | Carbs: 2.7 g | Fat: 22.3 g Ingredients For the Chicken 	•	400 g boneless chicken thigh (or breast), cut into small cubes 	•	2 tsp ginger-garlic paste 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	½ tsp pepper 	•	1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder 	•	½ tsp turmeric powder 	•	1 tsp lemon juice 	•	Light brush or spray of oil for frying For the Mix 	•	1 small onion, thinly sliced 	•	1–2 green chilies, chopped 	•	3 tbsp fresh coriander leaves, chopped (divided) For the Yogurt Base 	•	1 cup thick curd (I used Amul High-Protein Curd) or Greek yogurt  	•	1 tsp garlic paste 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	½ tsp sugar For the Tadka 	•	1.5 tbsp mustard oil 	•	½ tsp turmeric powder 	•	1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder 	•	1 tsp kasuri methi, crushed Method 1️⃣ Mix chicken with ginger-garlic paste, salt, pepper, Kashmiri chili powder, turmeric, and lemon juice. Rest 10–15 minutes. 2️⃣ Brush or spray a pan with very little oil. Pan-fry chicken on medium-high until golden brown. Transfer to a bowl. 3️⃣ Add sliced onion, chopped chilies, and half the coriander. Mix well and set aside. 4️⃣ In another bowl, whisk thick curd with garlic paste, salt, and sugar until smooth and creamy. 5️⃣ Heat mustard oil until smoking hot. Turn off the heat, add turmeric, Kashmiri chili powder, and crushed kasuri methi. 6️⃣ Pour the hot tadka into the curd and swirl gently to keep the streaks. 7️⃣ Pour the yogurt mixture over the chicken mixture. Mix gently. Finish with more chopped coriander leaves. Enjoy with soft rotis or steaming hot rice. . How to build an AI employee that works while you sleep. An AI agent is just a loop (goal → step → check → repeat) that can reach for tools. On its own it hits a wall: it forgets everything, waits for you, owns nothing. The ladder that turns it into staff: • ① context — files YOU write; it reads them every run so nothing's generic, and they grow (you're raising it) • ② memory — facts + your rules + how-to's; a skill is a memory • ③ a lane, not a task • ④ tools — MCP, ~1 min to connect • ⑤ a schedule — wakes on its own, pings you only for decisions • ⑥ guardrails — low-stakes it does; high-stakes it drafts and waits for your yes I run mine from a Google Sheet — it drafts every reply in my voice, I approve in 10 minutes, every 30 minutes it sends the approved ones and learns from my revisions. The moat: anyone can buy the same AI. Nobody has your context. Come build it with me. #aiemployee #aiagent #aiautomation #professorglitch

👀🍫FUDGY BROWNIE CHEESECAKE BARS…  No baking required. Makes 7 BIG bars, each with: 240 cals, 10g protein, 10 net carbs Here is another viral recipe that absolutely holds up to the hype. You’ve got a rich brownie base, a creamy cheesecake center, and a chocolate layer right on top. These are a little more dense than your traditional brownie cheesecake bar, but made with better-for-you ingredients, incredibly satisfying, and SO GOOD. Big thanks to @nora.dora99 for this amazing recipe! Here’s how to make them: FOR THE BROWNIE BASE: 150g almond flour 30g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 3 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Splash of vanilla extract Mix everything together until you have a brownie batter. Press it firmly into a parchment-lined loaf pan or small baking dish and freeze for 10 mins. FOR THE CHEESECAKE LAYER: 250g fat-free cream cheese (regular works too!) 10g sweetener of choice Splash of vanilla extract Squeeze of lemon juice I processed this in a food processor, but you can also use a hand mixer. Then spread it over the brownie base and freeze for about 45 mins. FOR THE CHOCOLATE TOPPING: 40g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 2 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Mix until smooth, spread it over the cheesecake layer, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set. I cut these into 7 bars, but you can cut them into whatever size bars you like to manage your own goals. Cut your cucumbers into 1 inch pieces and crush them with a mallet 2. In a bowl, add your cucumbers and salt and set aside for 10 minutes. 3. Drain all excess liquid, rise your cucumbers with water, pat them dry with a paper towel, and in a new bowl add rice vinegar, minced, garlic, sesame oil, sesame seeds, soy sauce, brown sugar, and gochugaru and mix well to make your spicy cucumber kimchi 4. Season your chicken evenly with salt, pepper, and cornstarch 5. In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, minced garlic, and minced ginger to make your glaze 6. In a pan on medium hear coated with spray oil, cook your chicken until golden brown, then flip and cook until both sides are golden brown with a crispy crust 7. Lower the heat to low and pour your glaze on top of the chicken and let it sit for 1 minute 8. One-Pan Chicken & Rice aka Arroz con Pollo 🥘 @HexClad @Goya Foods @Kerrygold USA @getgraza  Ingredients * 2–3 lbs chicken thighs * 2 cups rice * 4 cups chicken broth or water * 1 red bell pepper, diced * ½ medium onion, diced * ½ cup carrots, diced * 4 garlic cloves, minced * 2–3 tbsp butter * Olive oil * 1-2 tbsp chicken bouillon * Salt, to taste * Fresh cilantro, for garnish * Paprika * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Goya Adobo seasoning Instructions 1. Dice the red bell pepper, onion, and carrots, and mince the garlic. 2. Season both sides of the chicken thighs with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and Goya Adobo. 3. Heat a little olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Sear the chicken thighs for about 4 minutes per side, or until they develop a beautiful golden crust. Remove the chicken and set aside. 4. In the same pan, add the bell pepper, onion, carrots, and garlic. Add 2–3 tablespoons of butter and sauté for a few minutes, until fragrant. 5. Add 2 cups of rice and sauté it with the vegetables for another 1–2 minutes. 6. Pour in 4 cups of chicken broth (or water) and stir in chicken bouillon. Taste the liquid and add salt or more chicken bouillon if needed. 7. Nestle the chicken thighs back on top of the rice. Pour in any juices that collected on the plate—don’t waste that flavor! 8. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for about 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken is fully cooked (165°F internally). 9. Turn off the heat and leave the pan covered for another 5–10 minutes before serving. 10. Finish with fresh cilantro and serve. #chickenandrice #EasyRecipe #mealprep #arrozconpollo #DinnerIdeas

EASY & DELICIOUS PROTEIN PREP 🔥 Episode 1️⃣   I’ve just discovered the best way to meal prep chicken for the week. Follow me for tomorrow's video where I’ll show you 3 easy recipes to make with it!  Take your chicken, marinate in incredible flavours and roast it in the oven and you are left with the juiciest and most delicious chicken for the week.  Calories & macros (when divided into 5) 📊 296 calories 36g P | 5g C | 14g F This is week’s 1 of this new recipe series and all you need to do is:  1. Add 900g boneless, skinless chicken thighs to a large bowl or tub. You can trim off the excess fat if you want but I left it . 2. Blitz 1 white onion in a food processor & add it to the chicken.  3. Add the 2 tbsp of lemon juice, 3 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp sriracha & 2 tbsp plain or greek yogurt 4. Add 3-4 pinches salt, black pepper, 1.5 tbsp thyme, 1.5 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp chilli powder   5. Mix really well and marinate for 2-6 hrs, but even better overnight. You can also make it right away if you like. The longer you leave it, the better the flavour!  6. When you're ready to eat, preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius 375F. Remove chicken from the fridge and let it come up to room temp (about 30 mins) before placing in the oven. 7. Pack the marinated chicken tightly into a loaf pan (my measurements were 8.5x4.5x2.5). Place in the oven for 50 mins. 8. Remove the chicken from the oven, gently tilt the pan into a glass jar to remove the excess juices. Pour the juices over the chicken, then repeat. Set juices aside and use for soups. 9. Flip loaf pan onto a cutting board and cut chicken thin slices or strips. I portioned mine into 5 but you can also make it into 6.  Serve however you want. Follow for tomorrow's video where I’ll show you 3 easy recipes you can make with this prepped chicken!

WANT MOIST CHICKEN? These are the 2 simple cooking hacks for the juiciest chicken you’ve ever had. I usually do chicken thighs, but this is an amazing way to make regular chicken super moist! You need a little baking soda, to cook with the lid on & let it rest, and you’ll never have dry boring chicken again. Ingredients 2 chicken brst 1 tbsp olive oil 1/4 tsp baking soda 1 tsp oregano 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp smoked paprika Juice and zest of 1 small lemon Salt & pepper to taste Optional: 2 tbsp  yogurt Here is how I made it: 1.Add 2 chicken brsts to a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp baking soda to soften up the fibers, the zest & juice of a lemon, and optional: 2 tbsp plain yogurt. Mix well, and make sure the chicken is at room temperature (not cold!) This is important!! 2.Let this marinate for 30 minutes (outside of the fridge). By not using cold chicken, it help cook the chicken evenly. 3.Bring a pan to medium heat. Once it’s hot, place the chicken in the pan. Cover with a lid and cook for 3 mins on the first side. This is going to trap the moisture. 4.After 3 mins, flip it, cover with the lid, reduce heat to MEDIUM-LOW, and let it cook for another 7-8 mins. If you used cold chicken, or if your pan wasn’t hot enough, or if your chicken was too thick, this may require more time (and not be juicy, so follow the directions! 5. After 7-8 minutes remove the chicken from the pan, place it on a cutting board or plate, and let it rest for at least 5 minutes. This allows the juices to redistribute throughout the chicken, making it more tender and locking in the juices.   6.After resting, slice the chicken breasts against the grain and serve. You can serve this however way you wish – with your favorite veggies, salad, or with rice, quinoa, or if you’re looking for lowcarb/keto options, my @Kaizen Food Company lowcarb rice. We put it to the ultimate Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) test, and the results were absolutely shocking. 🤯 Yesterday, regular wheat (aata) roti gave us a massive spike, leaving us super stressed. So, we tested the exact same weight of Ragi roti today, expecting much safer numbers. We waited a few hours, checked the monitor, and... trust me, you are not ready for this. My spike was a complete record-breaker—it matched the exact same spike I got from drinking straight pineapple juice!  And my mom's graph? It shot up even higher than the regular wheat roti! 📈 My mom used to have diabetes, but she brought it completely under control two years ago by giving up all types of roti. This test proved exactly why. I even pulled out the packets to compare the nutrition labels, and the truth about Ragi's fiber and net carbs compared to regular wheat will surprise you. The numbers don't lie. Watch the video to see the real-time graph and the final numbers! If you are looking for truly healthy, low-spike alternatives, check out my page for recipes like my Tofu Scramble, Gajar Ka Halwa, and Chocolate Pudding. ✅ Next up: We are testing Bajra ki Roti.
